item.title: Canada lowered a retired Boeing 737 onto the seabed off Vancouver Island; now it serves as an artificial reef for marine life
item.description: In an innovative environmental initiative, a Boeing 737 from Canadian Airlines has been transformed into an artificial reef off the coast of Chemainus, British Columbia. Sunk in 2006, this aircraft has undergone a thorough cleaning by dedicated volunteers before its descent. Now known as Xihwu Reef, it has become a thriving ecosystem, supporting over a hundred different marine species that benefit from the habitat provided by this repurposed aircraft. item.title: Antwerp's 'human zoo': Belgium confronts shame of colonial past
item.description: In 1894, when the Belgian city of Antwerp was hosting a World's Fair, more than a hundred Congolese people were forcibly brought to the city to be exhibited in the Congo Pavilion. In this "human zoo", seven Congolese men ultimately died of disease. Today, this shocking episode still haunts Belgium as one of its colonial history's darkest chapters. This year, a monument to the victims was unveiled. Report by Alix le Bourbon and Dave Keating. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Tupac murder trial: Cans the prosecution use the defendant's words against him?
item.description: Who killed Tupac Shakur? Os períodos de restrição para quem fez endoscopia ou usou certos medicamentos caem de seis para quatro meses. Quem realizou tatuagem ou procedimentos estéticos em locais seguros pode doar após sete dias. A triagem passa a incluir teste de malária, e o prazo de validade das plaquetas foi ampliado de cinco para sete dias.
